title: Louis Bellson
summary: He admires Louis Bellson's clean playing.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, listen, you said too Louis Bellson is one of the guys you admired.
Oh, yes, he's terrific. He plays so clean, till it sounds to me like he's reading it out of the book, he just plays so clean.
Oh, yes, he can swing, he can swing.
He sounded very good in Ellington's band.
Big, heavy band and he could move that band, couldn't he?
He certainly did. He moved that band, too.
Is he? I don't know him real well. He's a very sweet guy.
